US500_1m_r7._comment: From US500_1m_r6. Structural change: replaces label-based precision penalty with label-agnostic expected-profit term using precomputed per-bar barrier outcomes (sell_outcome/buy_outcome from calculate_trade_outcomes_all_candles, already in dataset). Core insight: precision penalty punishes model for predicting trades on regime-filtered FLAT bars even when those bars have positive realised outcomes; profit term rewards/penalises based on actual market truth regardless of label. Changes: (1) profit_weight 0â†’5.0: expected_profit = mean(p_sellÃ—sell_out + p_buyÃ—buy_out); -profit_weightÃ—expected_profit added to loss. (2) pr_weight 9.0â†’2.0: reduced from a dominant penalty to a gentle label-quality regulariser so regime-approved SELL/BUY labels still get extra reward over equally profitable FLAT-labelled bars. (3) direction_penalty 0.5â†’0.0: profit term handles direction implicitly. (4) recall_floor 0.20â†’0.10: collapse guard only. (5) rec_floor_weight 30â†’15: gentler hinge with lower floor. gamma 2.0 unchanged. Pair with model-profile US500_1m_r4. R1: best_val_ep=4 val_loss=1.369 profit=15 prec_S=0.455 prec_B=0.506 rec_S=0.110 rec_B=0.185 ppt=0.020; best_ppt_ep=10 profit=21 ppt=0.041 prec_S=0.444 prec_B=0.530 rec_S=0.071 rec_B=0.138. First run with positive validation PnL, but pft stayed tiny (0.003 at best_val, ~0.000 at best_ppt) while rec_loss fired in 6/14 epochs, so the loss still underweights PnL and slightly penalises the highest-quality low-volume regime. Superseded by US500_1m_r8.

US500_1m_r8._comment: From US500_1m_r7. R7 R1 achieved the first positive validation PnL for US500 (best_val_ep=4 profit=15, ppt=0.020; best_ppt_ep=10 profit=21, ppt=0.041) with acceptable precision (0.455/0.506 at best_val, 0.444/0.530 at best_ppt), proving the composite profit+precision design works. However the profit term remained too weak: pft was only 0.003 at best_val and ~0.000 at best_ppt versus prâ‰ˆ1.07-1.10, so val-loss selection still mostly tracked precision rather than PnL per trade. Also recall_loss fired in 6/14 epochs (43%), above the >30% threshold for a floor set too high for a quality-first regime; the best-ppt epoch was penalised for rec_S=0.071 despite producing the highest trade quality. Changes: (1) profit_weight 5.0â†’20.0 to make realised-outcome optimisation materially visible in val_loss and pull checkpoint selection toward higher-ppt epochs. (2) recall_floor 0.10â†’0.08 because 0.10 was activating too often for a model whose natural high-quality operating point is slightly below 0.10 on SELL. (3) rec_floor_weight 15â†’10 to keep the lower floor as a gentle collapse guard rather than a competing objective. Keep pr_weight=2.0, gamma=2.0, direction_penalty=0.0 unchanged because precision is now acceptable and the label-quality bias is desirable. R1 (stopped at ep4): best_ep=2 val_loss=1.487 profit=-87 prec_S=0.410 prec_B=0.447 rec_S=0.117 rec_B=0.234 ppt=-0.089. profit_weight=20 overshot badly: pft stayed strongly positive (0.048 at best ep, 0.091 at ep1), meaning the model was still assigning probability mass to negative-outcome trades while the enlarged profit term dominated optimisation. All epochs negative PnL; worse than r7 on both val-loss-selected and ppt-selected checkpoints. Superseded by US500_1m_r9.

US500_1m_r9._comment: From US500_1m_r8. R8 R1 showed that profit_weight=20 was severely too aggressive. The core diagnostic: pft stayed strongly positive throughout (0.091 at ep1, 0.048 at best ep2), meaning the model was consistently predicting trades on negative-outcome bars while the 20x-amplified gradient caused chaotic boundary shifts. BUY near-collapsed at ep0 (B=36, rec_B=0.005) because the large gradient immediately crushed all BUY predictions. Every epoch was negative PnL (best ppt=-0.089 vs r7 best_ppt=+0.041). Root cause: for US500 1m bars, the base rate of profitable outcomes is structurally below 50% across all 50k val bars (not just labelled ones), so a high profit_weight persistently pushes the model toward predicting FLAT. Changes: (1) profit_weight 20.0Ã¢â€ â€™7.0: conservative increment from r7's 5.0 Ã¢â‚¬â€ enough to strengthen the profit signal without triggering gradient chaos; the step from 5Ã¢â€ â€™20 skipped several intermediate points that may be stable. (2) pr_weight 2.0Ã¢â€ â€™3.0: precision dropped to 0.410/0.447 at r8 best epoch vs r7's 0.455/0.506; extra label-quality gradient needed to counteract profit term's push toward FLAT. (3) recall_floor 0.09Ã¢â€ â€™0.10: restore r7's working floor value; with profit_weight still present and pushing toward FLAT, 0.10 provides firmer collapse guard than 0.09. (4) rec_floor_weight 10Ã¢â€ â€™15: unchanged from r9 prior Ã¢â‚¬â€ appropriate strength for a 0.10 floor. Keep gamma=2.0, direction_penalty=0.0 unchanged. Pair with model-profile US500_1m_r4 (not r5 Ã¢â‚¬â€ regression in r8 was the loss profile, not the architecture). R1 (16 epochs, patience=10): best_ep=5 val_loss=2.022 prec_S=0.394 prec_B=0.483 ppt=-0.054 Ã¢â‚¬â€ all 16 epochs negative PnL. pr_weight=3.0 inflated val_loss to 2.0-2.3 (vs r7's 1.37), drowning the profit signal (pft=0.010 vs pr=1.71 at best_ep). recall_floor fired 63% of epochs (eps 6-15); gnorm escalated 16Ã¢â€ â€™81; overfitting gap +0.291 at ep5, +1.306 at ep13. Precision regressed to 0.394/0.483 vs r7's 0.455/0.506. Superseded by US500_1m_r10.

US500_1m_r10._comment: From US500_1m_r9. R9 R1 diagnosed three compounding failures: (1) pr_weight=3.0 inflated val_loss to 2.0-2.3 (vs r7's 1.37) and reduced the profit signal to ~0.5% of total gradient (pft=0.010 vs pr=1.71 at best_ep) Ã¢â‚¬â€ the precision penalty completely drowned the profit term; (2) recall_floor=0.10 fired 63% of epochs (eps 6-15, above 30% threshold), creating frequent destabilising gradient conflicts as the model's natural operating recall with high pr_weight dips below 0.10; (3) precision actually regressed vs r7 (0.394/0.483 vs 0.455/0.506) despite higher pr_weight Ã¢â‚¬â€ inflated loss scale destabilised rather than improved precision. Changes: (1) pr_weight 3.0Ã¢â€ â€™2.0: revert to r7's working value; r9 proved 3.0 inflates the loss scale and makes training unstable without improving precision. (2) profit_weight 7.0Ã¢â€ â€™6.0: conservative one-step increment above r7's proven 5.0 Ã¢â‚¬â€ keeps profit signal at ~2-3% of total gradient (vs r7's ~0.2% which was too weak for val_loss selection to track ppt). (3) recall_floor 0.10Ã¢â€ â€™0.08: fired 43% in r7 and 63% in r9 (both above 30% threshold); 0.08 sits below the model's natural operating recall of 0.09-0.13, guarding against collapse without triggering every other epoch. rec_floor_weight=15.0, gamma=2.0, direction_penalty=0.0 unchanged. Next: R3 with intended config: 1.5M rows + US500_1m_dev labels. Key finding: SELL precision stuck at 0.335-0.425 (below 0.40 floor every epoch) while BUY precision reached 0.557 at ep4 (BUY profit=+23); profit_weight=6.0 appears to asymmetrically over-reward BUY vs SELL vs r7 which had prec_S=0.455 with profit_weight=5.0. Val_loss bounced ep5 (1.535) and never recovered to ep4 best (1.415); overfitting gap grew +0.172 (ep4) to +0.654 (ep9). Superseded by US500_1m_r11.

prod._comment: Production default. High precision bias with strong recall floor to prevent class collapse.

balanced._comment: Softer precision lever. Useful for instruments with sparse labels.

high_precision._comment: Maximum precision pressure. Use when signal quality matters more than coverage.

high_recall._comment: Lower precision pressure. Catches more entries at the cost of precision.

EURUSD_M1_prod_r16._comment: From EURUSD_M1_prod_r15. Core issue: SELL drag â€” prec_S=0.456 at best_pnl_ep never cleared 0.50 break-even; BUY was profitable (prec_B=0.513-0.544) while SELL consistently lost. (1) pr_weight_sell 10.0->12.0: asymmetric precision push to drive prec_S toward 0.50; SELL precision trailed BUY by ~0.07 every epoch. (2) pr_weight_buy 10.0->9.0: BUY already above target, ease to maintain BUY volume and reduce gradient magnitude. (3) pr_weight 10.0->10.5: harmonic mean of new sell/buy weights as symmetric fallback. (4) recall_floor 0.10->0.12: r15 late-epoch SELL recall naturally landed at mean=0.084 median=0.081; with pr_weight_sell=12.0, SELL recall is expected to drop further to ~0.04-0.06. Floor raised to 0.12 to provide a stronger collapse guard â€” same firing frequency as 0.10 (model recall already below both), but 2.3x more corrective force. NOT raised to 0.15 (would be 20-27%% of total loss, likely destabilising) or 0.20 (56%%, would dominate). (5) rec_floor_weight 65->50: compensates for higher floor magnitude; keeps rec component at ~9-10%% of total loss (vs 4%% with floor=0.10/w=65 at r15 operating recall), preventing the recall hinge from overwhelming the precision signal. R16: best_ep=11 val_loss=5.0293 prec_S=0.441 prec_B=0.444 ppt=-0.076 (best_pnl_ep17 profit=-42 ppt=-0.070) -- ALL EPOCHS NEGATIVE PnL. Key failures: (a) pr_weight_sell=12.0 drove rec_S below floor=0.12 in 8/19 epochs (42%), creating SELL precision/recall feedback loop -- model oscillated between high-precision/low-recall and low-precision/high-recall for SELL without converging; (b) BUY precision collapsed from r15 0.51-0.54 to 0.39-0.45 -- reducing pr_weight_buy 10->9 combined with asymmetric gradient competition caused BUY to lose quality; (c) val_loss regressed vs r15 (5.03 vs 4.37) -- higher precision pressure made loss harder to minimize without metric gains; gnorm escalated 30->235 identically to r15 pattern (LR reduction had zero effect). Overfitting gap improved 1.40->1.11 (wd increase working). Superseded by EURUSD_M1_prod_r17.

EURUSD_M1_prod_r17._comment: From EURUSD_M1_prod_r16. Root cause of r16 failure: (a) pr_weight_sell=12.0 + recall_floor=0.12 created irresolvable SELL precision/recall feedback loop -- floor fired 42% of SELL epochs in convergence phase, permanently opposing the precision gradient; SELL precision stagnated at 0.441 (vs 0.439 r15 -- zero improvement despite 20% more SELL pressure). (b) pr_weight_buy=9.0 collapsed BUY precision 0.51-0.54 (r15) -> 0.39-0.44 (r16). Changes: (1) pr_weight_sell 12.0->11.0: retain modest SELL bias (1.0 unit over BUY) but reduce absolute magnitude; at 12.0, pr pressure drove rec_S below 0.12 floor 42% of time; at 11.0, model should operate at slightly higher recall, reducing floor-firing frequency. (2) pr_weight_buy 9.0->10.0: restore r15 level where BUY was reliably >50% break-even (prec_B 0.513-0.544); reducing buy weight by 1.0 in r16 collapsed BUY precision catastrophically. (3) recall_floor 0.12->0.10: restore r15 level; 0.12 fires in 42% of SELL epochs once model converges (ep10-18), creating constant opposing force to precision optimization; 0.10 acts as pure collapse guard and should fire rarely with pr_weight_sell=11.0. (4) rec_floor_weight 50->65: restore r15 level; appropriate decisive correction for 0.10 floor (fires rarely but powerfully). Expected: BUY precision restored to 0.50+; SELL precision to improve modestly toward 0.46-0.48; positive PnL if both near/above break-even. | R17: best_ep=10 val_loss=5.1536 prec_S=0.392 prec_B=0.461 ppt=-0.127 -- ALL EPOCHS NEGATIVE PnL. SELL precision ceiling confirmed at ~0.40 for 3rd consecutive run (r15/r16/r17 best_ep prec_S: 0.439/0.441/0.392) despite pr_weight_sell escalating 10->12->11: covariance of pw_sell vs prec_S is near-zero; more SELL pressure yields no precision gain. BUY trending toward 0.50+ in late epochs (ep17 prec_B=0.507 with 134 preds) confirming headroom exists. rec_floor fired 5/18 epochs=28% (borderline, acceptable). gnorm 29->210 (improving: r15=241, r16=235, r17=210 with wd trend 0.009->0.011->0.012). Overfitting gap +0.98 at ep17 (r15=+1.40, r16=+1.11 -- trend continues). SELL ceiling is a data/label structural limit; strategy shift in r18: invert asymmetry (pr_weight_sell->9.0, pr_weight_buy->11.0) to let BUY carry PnL.

EURUSD_M1_prod_r18._comment: From EURUSD_M1_prod_r17. Strategic pivot based on 3-run evidence: SELL precision is structurally capped at ~0.40-0.44 (below 0.50 break-even for tp=sl=2.5). Increasing pr_weight_sell (10->12->11 across r15/r16/r17) produced no improvement in prec_S (0.439/0.441/0.392 at best_ep -- near-zero covariance). BUY has clear headroom: prec_B trended 0.461->0.507 across r17 epochs and r15 reliably held 0.513-0.544. Changes: (1) pr_weight_sell 11.0->9.0: accept SELL at its natural precision ceiling; lower SELL pressure reduces SELL volume so fewer low-precision trades create drag. (2) pr_weight_buy 10.0->11.0: BUY has demonstrated precision headroom; push toward 0.52+. (3) pr_weight 10.5->10.0: arithmetic mean of new asymmetric weights (fallback). All other params unchanged -- recall_floor=0.10 and rec_floor_weight=65.0 working correctly (fired 5/18 = 28% of r17 epochs, below 30% alert threshold). Expected: fewer SELL preds at ~0.40-0.42, more selective BUY at 0.50-0.55+; positive PnL target if BUY alone compensates SELL drag.

US500_1m_r17._comment: From US500_1m_r16. ONE CHANGE: recall_floor 0.10->0.05. At plateau prec=0.33, L_prec reaches 88% of total loss â€” near TradeProfitabilityLoss territory â€” so two mitigations: vol_floor_weight 200->250 (strong floor guard) + alpha_power=0.45 (recall bias 8.5x->5.0x, gives precision room vs recall counter-force). US500_gvfl_r6._comment: From r5. Fix: split precision signal into safety floor + reward band. prec_floor=0.34 is BELOW r5 natural equilibrium (~0.37), keeping hinge silent and val_loss clean. prec_target=0.42 + prec_reward_weight=0.5 provide a continuous linear incentive in the 0.34-0.42 band (gradient=-0.5/unit vs CE equilibrium). alpha_power=0.45 retained  it demonstrably shifted equilibrium +4pp vs r1. Best r5 gated_pnl=143 at ep4 (precS=0.393) shows 0.38+ precision is reachable; reward band targets locking that in at convergence rather than just transiently. R1: best_val_ep=16 val_loss=0.0495; best_gated_ep=9 gated_pnl=122 gated_ppt=0.079 prec_S=0.411 prec_B=0.357 â€” cleaner loss than r5 but weaker trading result; no epoch reached dual 0.38 precision.

US500_gvfl_r8._comment: From US500_gvfl_r7. Aggressive precision-first run requested by user with recall tolerated down to ~0.20-0.25. Lowered alpha_power 0.45->0.35 to reduce SELL/BUY recall bias and shift the CE equilibrium upward in precision. Raised gamma 2.5->3.0 to focus learning on harder minority-class examples after volume support was proven healthy. Kept prec_floor at 0.33 as a silent safety floor, but widened the active reward objective by raising prec_target 0.40->0.44 and prec_reward_weight 0.75->1.0 so the model is explicitly paid to trade recall for cleaner signals. Lowered vol_floor 0.065->0.060 to give more guard headroom before the hinge fires: alpha_power=0.35 reduces inherent minority-class CE pull vs 0.45, risking raw S+B preds drifting toward the floor (~3,120 at 0.065 on 48k val); lowering to 0.060 (~2,880) keeps the guard as a collapse backstop without contaminating val_loss during normal precision-focused operation.
